title: A tour of the block types

blocks.markdown:
## Welcome

This sample shows every **generic** block type the player supports today.

- text, pictures, audio with a transcript
- seven kinds of question, marked in your browser

Nothing you answer leaves this device.

blocks.alt: A page from a textbook exercise
blocks.caption: A picture block. The picture is inside the module.

blocks.title: An audio block
blocks.transcript: The narration of this clip is shown here as a transcript.

blocks.text: Information panels hold a tip or an instruction. Nothing to answer.

feedback.incorrect: Look for the word that names a thing.

blocks.question: Which are advantages of a long vacation?

blocks.statement: A con is a reason against something.

blocks.prompt: Write one pro of a short vacation.
